summary: EP 59 (the finale) STAYS CANON AND ANCHORS AT END 121 [START 119] {119, 120, 121} vol 14, with the post-series continue at ch 122 (C5) — one anchor, one continue, one note repair, no retypes, and rows 49 / 51 / 58 untouched as ordered. THE STORED NOTE WAS STALE AND IS REPLACED: it read 「finale adapts ch 120 + first half of ch 121 (Kunieda vs Agiel, Oga vs Jabberwock)」, but Kunieda vs Agiel is ch 119 (the arc page cites 「Chapter 119, pages 9-19」 and the chapter ends on the Pretty Flower Storm spread), ch 119 was missing from the note entirely, and ch 121 is adapted past its "first half" — its closing pages, Quetzalcoatl's game declaration, are animated. WHAT THE PAGES AND THE BROADCASTER SAY. Pages read on MangaDex's English uploads of chs 119-122: ch 119 p1 is Furuichi sensing Koma around Kunieda (the Japanese review's first beat for this episode), ch 119's last page ends Aoi vs Agiel, ch 121's late pages carry «THE ONLY FATHER HE HAS IN THIS WORLD.» and Sodom's second gulp, its closing pp 16-17 (the arc page's own cite) carry «IF YOU WANT THEM BACK, FACE ME IN A MATCH.», and ch 122 p1 opens «A GAME?». YTV's own archived back-number synopsis walks the same three chapters (「魔力を帯びた新必殺技で対抗！」 / 「柱師団の大将を受け継いだベヘモットの息子だった」 / 「スーパーミルクタイムを駆使しても全く歯がたたない」), and Bandai Channel, thetv.jp and two contemporaneous per-episode reviews agree beat for beat; MangaUpdates' anime.end = "Vol 14, Chap 121" is the cross-check. beelzebub.fandom (chapter pages + arc page + episode page) and animefillerguide are ONE lineage and counted once. THE TYPING, WITH ITS FORK NAMED. Canon CONFIRMED AS STORED: chs 119-121 are the episode end to end, ja-Wikipedia's declared legend leaves バブ59 unbolded while bolding バブ51-57 and バブ60, and animefillerlist prints "Manga Canon". But the closing minutes are an anime-original coda (no source times it; my estimate is 4-6 of ~21) — Beel eats Hilda's croquette, Oga and Beel synchronise, Sodom is destroyed and Hilda is freed where the manga keeps her captive, and the Pillars' death-games are played as twister — recorded as divergence{121}, with abridged{119-121} for the cuts the reviewer names. Under T28's faithfulness clause that is a divergence on a canon row; the mixed reading is flagged for Sean and would not move the anchor. THE CONTINUE: ch 121 is finished on the page, so C1 does not apply and C5 gives 122 — ch 122 is adapted by no episode, ch 123's homeroom was grafted early into ep 58 (ruled), and the note warns that from ch 122 the manga proceeds with Hilda still captive.

anchors.why: END CONFIRMED AS STORED, PLUS THE START THE ROW LACKED; the stored note's content claim is replaced (see repairs). START 119 (A10, high confidence): eps 52-57 are filler on every source and ep 58 is ruled END 118 [116] (2026-09-05), so ch 119 is first-time here; beelzebub.fandom's ch 119 page 「激突!! VSアギエル!!」 carries |episode = [[We're the Strongest|59]] and no other episode; and the contemporaneous Japanese review's FIRST beat is ch 119 page 1 — 「まずは、コマちゃんの気配に気づく古市くん。」 with the quoted line 「邦枝先輩の周りに何かいるような」, which is exactly what MangaDex's ch 119 page 1 shows (Koma's true form above; balloons «IN THE SPACE AROUND KUNIEDA.» / «IT'S AS THOUGH THERE'S SOMETHING...», read as page images). One-lineage observation that does NOT move the START: the fandom's ep-59 cast list marks its first fourteen entries "(flashback)", i.e. a previously/flashback block over ep 58's material (chs 116-118) — re-shown pages are never a START (A10) and no second source describes it, so it is recorded here rather than annotated. END 121 (A4, high confidence): the fandom gives chs 119, 120 and 121 to ep 59 and to NO other episode, ch 122's page carries an EMPTY |episode field, and the episode page's own chapters field lists Chapter 119 / Chapter 120 / Chapter 121. Independently of that lineage: YTV's own back-number synopsis walks ch 119 (「コマちゃんの力を借りた葵も参戦し、魔力を帯びた新必殺技で対抗！」), ch 120 (「柱師団の大将を受け継いだベヘモットの息子だった」 and 「ところがそのヒルダは、突然現れた巨大なドラゴンに連れ去られてしまう」) and ch 121 (「スーパーミルクタイムを駆使しても全く歯がたたない」); the Japanese review quotes Hilda's ch-121 lines 「一度しか言わんからよく聞け」 and 「坊ちゃまを頼んだぞ」; and an independent English review walks the chapter to its MANGA outcome — «Oga instead attacks Sodom, freeing Hilda. But Hilda uses her powers to get Oga and Beel away as the dragon swallows her.» — and then names ch 121's CLOSING pages: «En tells them that if they want to win back their friends and their school they will have to face his servants in a series of games that they will have to risk their lives to win». Those closing pages are ch 121 pp 16-17 on the fandom's arc page and on MangaDex (Quetzalcoatl: «IF YOU WANT THEM BACK, FACE ME IN A MATCH.»; the last page's balloons «PRIDE» / «LOVE» / «FRIENDSHIP» / «BONDS» / «...AND YOUR LIFE... WILL ALL BE ON THE LINE.»). Ch 121 is therefore adapted THROUGH ITS LAST PAGE — nothing is left mid-chapter, C1 does not apply, and the continue is END + 1. MangaUpdates' coverage segment (anime.end = "Vol 14, Chap 121") agrees; cross-check only, never the basis. SLIVER CLAUSE, per segment — every segment here is SIGNIFICANT and FIRST-TIME, none is a duplicate: ch 119 because the whole chapter is the episode's first act and no other episode carries a page of it; ch 120 because the whole chapter carries the episode's turn (Jabberwock's introduction and Hilda's abduction); ch 121 because the aerial fight through Hilda's sacrifice (the arc page's pp 1-14) plus the closing game declaration (pp 16-17) are the episode's second half. No sliver, no graft, nothing re-shown from an earlier episode. VOLUME 14 on three sources: the stored boundary table (v14 = 116-124), the fandom's chapter infoboxes (|volume = [[Intrusion! Akumano Academy|14]]) and MangaDex's aggregate (chs 116-124 in vol 14) — the printed numbering, no shift to convert. LINEAGE (R3): beelzebub.fandom's chapter pages, arc page and episode page are ONE lineage, and animefillerguide's chapter column (119, 120, 121) is that lineage copied (batch 22 wave 3 established this row-for-row) — counted once. The independent readings are YTV's broadcaster synopsis, Bandai Channel, thetv.jp, the two contemporaneous reviews, and the manga pages themselves. en-Wikipedia is SILENT (its ShortSummary for eps 58 and 59 is empty) — silence, not a finding. QUOTE PROVENANCE (for the verifier): every ALL-CAPS quote in this verdict is lettering read off the MangaDex page IMAGES listed in the sources (chapter UUIDs 84fabc39 = ch 119, eb32cda4 = ch 120, 73fddebd = ch 121, 69659b94 = ch 122, English uploads), not text greppable on a web page; every 「…」 and «…» quote from a text source is byte-verbatim in the page cited beside it — with one gotcha, the fandom api.php JSON escapes Japanese as \uXXXX, so its kanji quotes (e.g. 「激突!! VSアギエル!!」) must be decoded before grepping.

continue_points.why: C5 POST-SERIES, with the covered-or-not test stated. Ep 59 is the anime's last adapting row (ep 60 is anime-original on every source), and its END is finished ON THE PAGE: Quetzalcoatl's game declaration is ch 121's own closing pages and it is animated, so nothing is straddled (C1 does not apply). The furthest FIRST-TIME coverage in running order is ch 121 (A4), so the continue is 121 + 1 = 122. THE UNSEEN RANGE, named: ch 122 「最強チーム」 is adapted by NO episode — its fandom page's |episode field is empty — and every chapter from 124 on is unadapted; ch 123 「悪魔野HR」 is the one exception in between, its Akumano Academy homeroom roster scene having been grafted forward into ep 58 (ruled 2026-09-05, graft{123}), so a reader arriving at 123 will find that classroom scene familiar and should still read the chapter in full. THE WARNING THE READER NEEDS (C3-style): the anime's last minutes DIVERGE from ch 121's outcome — the episode ends with Oga and Beel freeing Hilda and destroying Sodom, while the manga leaves Hilda captive — and ch 122 opens straight on the consequences (MangaDex ch 122 p1: Aoi's «A GAME?» and Zela's «HUMANS, PILLARS, WE ARE BOTH NOTHING MORE THAN HIS PAWNS.» / «THIS IS NOTHING MORE THAN A WAR GAME THAT OUR MASTER EN HAS STARTED.»), so read ch 122 expecting Hilda still in Behemoth's hands and the Pillar game still ahead. animefillerguide's reading block names the same chapter to start from, but it is the fandom lineage re-derived — a cross-check, not a second source.

annotations.note: weight: recorded so the CANON typing is auditable — an anime-original CODA appended after ch 121's content is exhausted, not an original half that carries the episode's plot (T28's faithfulness clause; chs 119-121 are the episode's spine, ~52 pages in one 22-minute slot). WHAT IT IS: after Hilda is swallowed a second time (ch 121's own outcome, animated), Beel eats a croquette Hilda made and Oga powers up — the Japanese review writes it as 「すーぱーころっけたいむぅぅぅぅぅ？」 and asks 「男鹿くんとベル坊の融合ってそんな簡単に起きるものなの？」 — Oga and Beel synchronise, destroy Sodom, crash into Ishiyama and level it, and Oga vanishes in his own attack (Bandai's ep-60 synopsis opens 「悪魔との激闘の中、自ら放った技に巻き込まれ、男鹿とベル坊が姿を消した」); and the Pillars' death-games are staged as a game of twister (English review: «I enjoyed the reduction of all the dangerous games to just a simple game of twister»). The manga has none of it, and the fandom's arc page states the departure outright (its [[links]] elided where marked): «In the anime, there was a major change in the story following» [[Chapter 121]] «of the manga. After Hilda was swallowed whole by Sodom, Oga and Baby Beel synchronized and defeated the dragon eventually freeing Hilda, as shown in» [[Episode 59]]. «Thus, she was not captured and so the following chapters were not depicted. The reason behind this is the cancellation of the» [[Beelzebub]] anime. SIZE, honestly: no source times it. Three independent readings place it at the very end and call it rushed — 「やっつけにも程がある」, «Instead we get a butt pull of an ending», «We get exactly what the manga gave us, minus the last few parts.» — and YTV's own synopsis stops at its set-up (「ヒルダからのあるものが、男鹿に新しい技のヒントを与える！」) instead of giving it the climax slot the way Bandai's ep-26 text gave that episode's original half. Estimate 4-6 minutes of ~21; the source occupies the rest. THE FORK IS FLAGGED for Sean: if he reads the coda as a substantial story-carrying share (it does resolve the arc), the row is MIXED — the anchor, START, END and continue are unchanged either way.

weight: recorded so the CANON typing is auditable — three chapters (~52 pages: 18 + 17 + 17 by the fandom's own page counts) are compressed into one 22-minute finale, so the telling is faithful but cut. The contemporaneous Japanese review opens 「さすが来週が最終回なだけあって、すごい勢いでストーリーが進んでた今週のべるぜバブ。」 and names a specific casualty with its reason: 「もう回数ないから原作の神姫コンビの「すごいバックステップ」なかわいいシーンは端折らざるを得ないんですよね」 (ch 119's Kanzaki/Himekawa beat, dropped because no episodes were left). Under T28's faithfulness clause, cuts of the source's own events keep the row CANON; this record is the audit trail, not a typing claim — the chapters are still adapted end to end, ch 119 to its last page and ch 121 to its last page.

repairs.old: research-tier (Sean sign-off 2026-08-23): finale adapts ch 120 + first half of ch 121 (Kunieda vs Agiel, Oga vs Jabberwock); Sean-verified 2026-08-23
repairs.new: research-tier (Sean sign-off 2026-08-23; CORRECTED batch 23 wave 1, read on the pages): the finale adapts chs 119-121 in running order. START ch 119 page 1 — Furuichi senses Koma around Kunieda (MangaDex ch 119 p1, balloons «IN THE SPACE AROUND KUNIEDA.» / «IT'S AS THOUGH THERE'S SOMETHING...») — and ch 119 runs to its own last page, the Pretty Flower Storm spread that ends Aoi vs Agiel (YTV: 「コマちゃんの力を借りた葵も参戦し、魔力を帯びた新必殺技で対抗！」). Ch 120: the controlled Ishiyama students, En and Quetzalcoatl; Behemoth hands the 34 Pillar Division to his son Jabberwock (YTV: 「柱師団の大将を受け継いだベヘモットの息子だった」); Sodom carries Hilda off; Oga clings to the dragon. Ch 121 to its last page: Super Milk Time fails (YTV: 「スーパーミルクタイムを駆使しても全く歯がたたない」), Hilda pushes Oga and Beel clear (MangaDex ch 121: «THE ONLY FATHER HE HAS IN THIS WORLD.») as Sodom swallows her again, then Quetzalcoatl declares the game («IF YOU WANT THEM BACK, FACE ME IN A MATCH.»). END 121 (A4), vol 14. THE ANIME THEN APPENDS AN ORIGINAL CODA the manga has no counterpart for: Beel eats Hilda's croquette, Oga and Beel synchronise, Sodom is destroyed, Ishiyama is levelled and Oga vanishes; the Pillars' death-game is played as twister (divergence{121}). That coda is why the manga's line resumes at ch 122 with Hilda STILL CAPTIVE (C5, continue 122). CORRECTIONS to the 2026-08-23 text: Kunieda vs Agiel is ch 119 (the arc page cites 「Chapter 119, pages 9-19」), not ch 120/121; ch 119 was missing from the note altogether; and ch 121 is not adapted only in its "first half" — its closing pages are animated too.
repairs.why: The stored note is wrong on three counts, and batch 22 wave 3's verifier lead is confirmed on the pages. (1) It never mentions ch 119, yet ch 119 is the episode's first act: beelzebub.fandom gives ch 119 to ep 59 and to no other episode, and the Japanese review's first beat is ch 119 page 1. (2) It attributes Kunieda vs Agiel to ch 120 + ch 121; the fight is ch 119 — the arc page cites 「Chapter 119, pages 9-19」 for it, and MangaDex's ch 119 ends on the Pretty Flower Storm spread carrying the chapter-end marker 「バブ119／おわり」. (3) "first half of ch 121" understates the coverage: ch 121's closing pages (Quetzalcoatl's game declaration) are animated — the English review names them and the Japanese review sees the game being played — so the chapter is adapted through its last page, and the continue is 122 rather than a C1 landing inside 121. The replacement also records the anime-original coda, which is the fact a reader actually needs at this row. END 121 is UNCHANGED (confirmed as stored); the START and chapters_adapted the row lacked are delivered in the anchor. `old` is the stored value exactly as the context file prints it (149 characters, inside context.ts's 200-character slice, so it is the whole stored note).

type_corrections.note: CONFIRMED AS STORED (canon). The episode's job is the source's: chs 119, 120 and 121 in running order, from ch 119 page 1 to ch 121's closing game declaration, with four independent readings agreeing on the beats (YTV's own back-number synopsis, Bandai Channel, thetv.jp's listing text and two contemporaneous per-episode reviews, one Japanese and one English). ja-Wikipedia's episode table is a positive witness under its own declared legend — 「アニメ版オリジナルストーリーのサブタイトルは、太字で表記するものとする」 — because バブ59 「オレたちが最強です」 is NOT bolded while バブ51-バブ57 and バブ60 are; the same editors footnoted バブ51 as half-original (「エピソードの半分はアニメオリジナルとなっている」) and wrote nothing on 59; and the article's prose names the original episodes as 「第51話 - 第57話および第60話（最終話）はアニメオリジナル回である」, excluding 58 and 59. animefillerlist prints "Manga Canon" for row 59 and animefillerguide flags no filler (those two are ONE lineage for types and are cited as one). THE ONE THING AGAINST IT, stated rather than buried: the last few minutes are an anime-original coda (see divergence{121}) that resolves the arc the manga leaves open — under T28's materiality bar that is a divergence on a canon row rather than an original half, and it is the fork this verdict flags for Sean.

structure.notes: THE TERMINAL, AND IT IS SINGLE-VALUED. Ep 59 is both the last row that adapts source pages and the max-chapter anchor (A4) — no honest-terminal split here: after the 2026-09-05 repairs the run 46 -> 101, 47 -> 105, 48 -> 110, 50 -> 113, 51 -> 115, 58 -> 118, 59 -> 121 is monotonic, and nothing in the anime reaches past ch 121 except ep 58's ruled graft of ch 123. Ep 60 「さよならは言いません」 is anime-original on every source (ja-WP bolds it and names it in the prose; animefillerlist "Filler"; YTV's own synopsis for it has the Great Demon Lord calling off the destruction of humanity and Beel returning to the demon world — none of that is the manga's chs 122-124, which continue the Pillar-game arc with Hilda captive, Saotome's training and Decapitation Island; the stored space runs to 240 known chapters in 28 volumes), so the post-series continue belongs on ep 59, where this verdict puts it. THE ADAPTATION STOPS MID-ARC, which is why the ep-59 divergence and the C5 note matter more than usual: the Akumano Academy arc's premise (the Pillar game, Hilda captive) is declared on ch 121's last pages and then abandoned, and the anime substitutes a victory. A reader handed only the number 122 would meet a captive Hilda the anime freed. WHAT THE STALE NOTE COST, for the record: the 2026-08-23 note (「finale adapts ch 120 + first half of ch 121」) dropped ch 119 entirely and mis-attributed Kunieda vs Agiel; the fight is ch 119 pp 9-19 (the arc page's own cite, confirmed on the pages — ch 119's last page is the Pretty Flower Storm spread carrying the chapter-end marker 「バブ119／おわり」). Left standing, it would have read ch 119 as never-adapted and ch 121 as half-adapted; both are wrong, and both are fixed here.

flags_for_sean: T28 FORK, canon vs mixed on ep 59 — YOUR CALL, and the anchor does not depend on it. Ep 59 adapts chs 119-121 essentially end to end (~52 pages) and then appends an anime-original coda that RESOLVES the arc: Beel eats Hilda's croquette, Oga and Beel synchronise, Sodom is destroyed, Hilda is freed (the manga leaves her captive) and Oga vanishes into ep 60. FOR CANON (what I delivered, matching the stored type): the source is the spine and the whole first act; T28's faithfulness clause treats an appended studio finish inside an otherwise faithful telling as divergence; ja-WP's own legend leaves 59 unbolded while marking 51-57 and 60, and footnotes ep 51 as half-original but not 59; YTV's licensor synopsis gives the climax slot to the source and only teases the coda. FOR MIXED: the coda is story-carrying — it ends the series' central conflict — and both contemporaneous reviewers describe the episode as ending in an anime-original ending. No source times the coda; my estimate from the beat lists is 4-6 minutes of ~21. If you rule mixed, the anchor (END 121 [119], chapters 119, 120, 121, vol 14) and the continue 122 stand unchanged and only the type flips.

THE STORED EP-59 NOTE IS REPLACED, and batch 22 wave 3's verifier lead is CONFIRMED ON THE PAGES: Kunieda vs Agiel is ch 119 — the arc page cites 「Chapter 119, pages 9-19」 for the fight and MangaDex's ch 119 ends on the Pretty Flower Storm spread with the chapter-end marker 「バブ119／おわり」 — not the ch 120/121 the 2026-08-23 note claimed; and "first half of ch 121" is wrong in the other direction, because ch 121's closing pages (Quetzalcoatl's game declaration) are animated too. The repair is note-only: END 121 is confirmed as stored, and the row gains START 119 and chapters_adapted "119, 120, 121" through the anchor.

READER-FACING DIVERGENCE ON THE CONTINUE. The anime's last minutes contradict the manga at the exact point the reader is sent to: the anime frees Hilda; the manga keeps her captive from ch 121 well past ch 124. The continue note carries the warning — if the UI ever shows only a number, this row is a candidate for surfacing the note beside it. Inside the same continue: ch 122 is adapted by no episode, while ch 123's homeroom scene WAS shown early in ep 58 (the ruled graft), so the reader should still read 123 in full.
